programs.title: Bros
programs.desc: Bobby is a neurotic podcast host who's happy to go on Tinder dates and content not to have a serious relationship. That all changes when he meets Aaron, an equally detached lawyer who likes to play the field. Repeatedly drawn to each other, both men begin to show their vulnerabie sides as their undeniable attraction turns into something resembling a commitment.

programs.title: Maybe It's You
programs.desc: On the heels of breakups, best friends Peter and Lexa decide to try the one thing they've never tried: dating each other. The big question is whether their chemistry will be enough to keep them afloat romantically.

programs.title: Keeping Up With the Kardashians
programs.desc: Kourtney is eager to experience Paris Fashion Week with Kim and see Kendall walk the runway for the first time, but their trip to the city of love takes a dark turn when Kim is robbed at gunpoint.

programs.title: E! Live From the Red Carpet
programs.desc: Zuri Hall is on the steps of the Met Gala while Justin Sylvester, Keltie Knight, Zanna Roberts Rassi, Ciara Miller, Bronwyn Newport and Renee Montgomery cover fashion; Erin Lim Rhodes meets celebs at The Pierre Hotel and the Glambot makes its debut.

programs.title: Big Daddy
programs.desc: Thirty-two-year-old Sonny Koufax (Adam Sandler) has spent his whole life avoiding responsibility. But when his girlfriend dumps him for an older man, he's got to find a way to prove he's ready to grow up. In a desperate last-ditch effort, Sonny adopts 5-year-old Julian (Dylan Sprouse), (Cole Sprouse) to impress her. She's not impressed ... and he can't return the kid. Uh-oh for Sonny!

programs.title: 50 First Dates
programs.desc: Playboy vet Henry sets his heart on romancing Lucy, but she has short-term memory loss. She can't remember anything that happened the day before. So every morning, Henry has to woo her again. Her friends and family are very protective and Henry must convince them that he's in it for love.
